notes.title: Announcement of PHC Demo Version & Crowdfunding [May 17, 2025]
notes.content:
Thank you for your continued support.

This time, I would like to announce the trial version of "Pomegranate housing complex" and the crowdfunding of this work.

There are a lot of events next week, so I will do my best.

[h2]About the Pomegranate housing complex demo version[/h2]

[h3]Scheduled release date[/h3]

[b]Tuesday, May 21, 2025[/b]

It is scheduled to be submitted for review on the 19th.
If it does not go well, it will be postponed.

As this is my first attempt and a personal production and sale, I think there will be many shortcomings, but I would appreciate your understanding. .

[h3]Distribution site[/h3]
[list]
[*] Steam
[*] itch.io
[*] BOOTH
[/list]

Currently, the trial version is scheduled to be distributed on the day [b]Windows only[/b].
This is because the author does not own a Mac due to his working environment... I'm sorry.

However, I'm hoping to release it on Mac as well, so I'd appreciate it if you could wait.

If it's difficult, I'm also considering releasing it on a browser version.

[h3]In-game specifications[/h3]

[list]

[*] Time: 30 seconds = 1 hour

[*] Surveillance area: up to 2nd floor

[*] Patrol area: up to 2nd floor

[*] Phone calls: 1 type (however, the conversation content changes depending on the conditions)

[*] Spiritual disturbance level: 3 levels

[*] Ending branch: 3 types (quite simple)

[/list]

Currently, volunteers are test-playing the provisional data.

Thankfully, there don't seem to be any fatal bugs... so if all goes well, it looks like it will only require minor corrections.

There are lots of gimmicks built in, so you might discover a lot of things if you play it a few times.

We look forward to seeing you all play it!

[h2]About Pomegranate housing complex Crowdfunding[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45577571/0b36f65de51bdd9c0cf7ba4271f774374bf56608.png[/img]

Although it will be very short notice, we will be releasing a crowdfunding page on CAMPFIRE.

[h3]Crowdfunding release date[/h3]

[b]Saturday, May 24, 2025[/b]

[h3]Purpose of doing crowdfunding[/h3]

Support for the production of the finished product version of "Pomegranate housing complex"

[h3]Target amount[/h3]

300,000 yen

[h3]Reason for doing crowdfunding[/h3]

Honestly, I'm very sorry...
I'm currently working part-time while developing games, but the physical and mental burden is piling up, and I'm in a position where I need to reconsider the way I work.

However, I feel very attached to "Pomegranate housing complex" so I absolutely want to complete it.

I decided to do crowdfunding so that I can have the time and environment to concentrate on creating, even if just a little.

(Although it's a hidden theme, I also hope that it will help with localization into various languages.)

I will provide more details at a later date, so please look forward to it.

We will also be exhibiting at an offline event in Tokyo on the 24th, so if you're in the area, please come and see us.

notes.title: Pomegranate Complex Production Monthly Report [May 8, 2025]
notes.content:
Thank you for your continued support.
I'd like to inform you of the progress of the production so far this month.
We are making great progress towards the release of the trial version on May 20th.

[h2]Graphics[/h2]
[h3]Surveillance camera graphics: 70%[/h3]
[list]
[*]I forgot to draw the stairs, so I need to fix that
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45577571/dc9527051ab33acad20251a171fed5c31751e5ca.gif[/img]

[h3]Patrol graphics: 60%[/h3]
[list]
[*]After thinking about it, I realized I hadn't drawn 3F and 4F
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45577571/690effe67b154d4cf718caf2b9203f17240cf952.jpg[/img]
[h3]Event graphics: 90%[/h3]
[list]
[*]Almost OK
[/list]

[h3]Various command graphics: 100%[/h3]
[list]
[*]It turned out great
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45577571/775fcfd7667f304d906f3feba425acd3667da67b.jpg[/img]

[h2]System[/h2]
[list]
[*]The basic system is almost done
[*]All that's left is to fix the fine details and adjust the spirit disturbance event
[/list]

[h2]Music[/h2]
[list]
[*]Volunteers will process and adjust the materials
[*]The materials themselves are almost done, so we plan to implement them in the game
[/list]

[h2]Future plans[/h2]
Currently, we're having difficulty with the spirit disturbance event.
The more we implement it, the more bugs there are, and the more work we have to do.

I'd like to have it ready for test play by next week, and focus on debugging and adjustment...!

Also, there will be an offline event on the 24th, so we'll be making progress on preparations for that.

[h2]Thank you for exceeding 1000 WL[/h2]

The other day, the wishlist for "Pomegranate housing complex" exceeded 1000!

Thank you so much.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45577571/0abe2dc4bfe40495e530cd3ba9d4780899d38c30.jpg[/img]

I've also included an illustration of when it exceeded 600 in the first two days.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45577571/bf798c9f65461af5fc557e4d64883bda04dd054a.jpg[/img]

We will do our best to meet your expectations, so please continue to support us.

Korekoreshikazika　Kizinago
